title: Important Update: CBIC Clarifies GST Rules on Refunds, Registration, and ITC Declarations
content:
# Important Update: CBIC Clarifies GST Rules on Refunds, Registration, and ITC Declarations

Ek important update hai for all taxpayers. Government ne Central Goods and Services Tax (Amendment) Rules, 2026, ke liye ek Corrigendum announce kiya hai. Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC) ne Notification No. G.S.R. 1001(E) dated November 18, 2026, ke through kayi clarifications aur corrections kiye hain, especially regarding GST refund revalidation, registration documentation, and Input Tax Credit (ITC) declarations.

Yeh corrections Central Goods and Services Tax (Amendment) Rules, 2026 ke English version mein kiye gaye hain, jo originally October 26, 2026 ko publish hue the.

**Key clarifications aur changes include:**

*   **GST Refund Revalidation Rules:**
    *   FORM GST RFD-06 (Refund Order) ko ab proper officer se revalidate karwane ki requirement nahi hogi.
    *   FORM GST RFD-05 (Payment Order) ki revalidation tab zaroori hogi agar refund payment order issue hone ke *same financial year* mein disburs nahi hota hai.
*   **Registration Documentation:**
    *   GST registration ke documentation requirements mein corrections kiye gaye hain.
    *   Kai jagahon par "permission" word ko "consent" se replace kiya gaya hai.
    *   Jahan bhi "seven days" mention tha, use "seven working days" mein badal diya gaya hai.
    *   Property tax receipts, municipal Khata, property identification, aur electricity/water bills jaise documentary references mein bhi revisions kiye gaye hain.
*   **ITC Declarations:**
    *   Refund application mein di jaane wali declaration ko correct kiya gaya hai. Ab explicitly mention hoga ki refund claimed mein Section 17(5) ke under unavailable ITC aur nil-rated ya fully exempt supplies ke liye use kiye गए goods or services par availed ITC shamil nahi hai.
    *   Declaration se capital goods par ITC ke earlier express reference ko hata diya gaya hai.

Yeh corrigendum GST compliance ko aur clear aur streamline karne ke liye ek important step hai.
